meta.name: Pluto TV Pixel World
meta.description:
Pluto TV Pixel World brings you giant blocks of all things Minecraft! Explore some of the wildest mods ever built and tag along with top gamers like Thinknoodles and PrestonPlayz. Don’t miss the excitement on Pluto TV Pixel World!

Shows: Minecraft Crazy Craft, TBNR Presents, Brianna is Leaving Minecraft Forever / Abandoned at my Sleepover in Minecraft, I Found a Creeper Only Minecraft Server! / How to Prank Cactus Jones as a Mob in Minecraft!, 100 Mystery Prison Buttons but Only One Lets You Escape / 100 Minecraft YouTuber Mystery Buttons
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
